_about: Public-domain Samuel Johnson (1696-1772), Anglican missionary in Connecticut and first president of King's College, New York, for the Word Hoard: The Elements of Philosophy (London: Millar, 1754), from an Internet Archive scan. Not Dr Samuel Johnson the lexicographer. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 42 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

johnson-ct-elements-philosophy: The elements of philosophy: containing, I. The most useful parts of logic, ... II. A brief view both of ... moral philosophy, ... By Samuel Johnson, D.D (London : printed for A. Millar, 1754)
